title: Facing cards: Peak ticket
topics: Two pointers, windows and prefix sums
summary: The readings are sorted ascending. Pair the first and last, then the second and second-last, until they meet. Produce each pair's sum in encounter order; an unpaired middle reading is recorded unchanged. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. descriptionMd:
A sorted card rack is inspected from both ends toward its middle divider. Tomas is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

The readings are sorted ascending. Pair the first and last, then the second and second-last, until they meet. Produce each pair's sum in encounter order; an unpaired middle reading is recorded unchanged.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement facingCardsPeakTicket(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Opposite-end pointers. The readings are sorted ascending. Pair the first and last, then the second and second-last, until they meet. Produce each pair's sum in encounter order; an unpaired middle reading is recorded unchanged. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with opposite-end pointers. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

The readings are sorted ascending. Pair the first and last, then the second and second-last, until they meet. Produce each pair's sum in encounter order; an unpaired middle reading is recorded unchanged. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [9,7,7]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 9.
The derived sequence is [2,8]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 8.
The derived sequence is []. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 0.
